title: WWW 2027 manuscript-aligned core aggregate results
precision: Exact displayed manuscript values; no unreported precision is inferred.
retention_policy: At least one complete, error/mock/empty-free, gold-equivalent executor replay; all Native chains retained

tables.caption_tex: Task and reference statistics for Augmented GAIA. Semantic records and compiled graph edges are different objects; reduced edges include the terminal-action policy. Construction counts precede replay; the ordering row distinguishes sampled and retained pools.

Three-facet scores for eleven closed-model and nine open-weight configurations. Planning/answers use 165 tasks; tools use 144 annotated tasks per configuration. Native uses the recorded chain; Augmented selects the best match over Native and replay-retained alternatives. $\Delta$: absolute EdgeF1 gain before rounding; NodeF1 is unchanged. Group means weight configurations equally. $^{\dagger}$Accepted: human-reviewed answer acceptance.

Native-to-Augmented gains on the original multi-order-rich cohorts, held fixed after replay filtering. Augmented uses Native and retained alternatives; NodeF1 is unchanged and omitted. Scores are equal-model means; $\Delta$ is absolute and $\Delta(\%)$ relative to Native, using unrounded scores. 95\% CIs use 2{,}000 paired task-cluster resamples retaining all configurations in each group.

Expected best-match EdgeF1 by reference budget on 56 tasks with at least two retained alternatives (nine open-weight configurations). Budgets 1 and 2 are exact expectations over uniform subsets of each retained pool. Gain pairs: expected fraction of 504 model--task pairs beating Native. Relative gains use Native; 95\% CIs cover absolute EdgeF1 gains (2{,}000 task-cluster resamples).

Within-model Pearson $r$ between retained-pool Augmented PlanningScore and binary human answer acceptance on tool-clean tasks ($n$: selected tasks). 95\% CIs use 5{,}000 task-bootstrap resamples, skipping draws where correlation cannot be calculated. CIs are not adjusted for the number of models compared.

Web-source EdgeF1: Native chain versus best match over Native and replay-retained alternatives (nine open-weight configurations). The 66-task source-defined slice is fixed; the nested 25- and 20-task slices require at least one and two retained alternatives, respectively. $\Delta$: absolute gain before rounding; 95\% CIs use 2{,}000 paired task-cluster resamples.

Native-to-Augmented EdgeF1 outcomes using replay-retained references across nine open-weight configurations. Gain/Tie count strict increases/unchanged scores; Rich 63 is the fixed pre-filter cohort with at least two sampled alternatives. Median gains among benefiting pairs are 0.1818 (all tasks) and 0.1818 (rich tasks).

Alignment-threshold sensitivity for eleven closed-model abstract planners (1{,}815 all-task/693 original-rich pairs). $\Delta$EdgeF1: mean Augmented $-$ Native using retained references. Spearman $\rho$: configuration ranks by mean Augmented PlanningScore versus $\xi=.45$, within each population.

ATS/TISR sensitivity across eleven closed-model and nine open-weight configurations. Counts cover configurations contributing to the means, which equally weight within-model Pearson correlations with binary human acceptance. $\bar r_N$/$\bar r_A$ use Native/retained-pool Augmented PlanningScore. Bold: default; ---: no TISR gate.

Abstract-plan scores on TaskBench and UltraTool (1{,}000 tasks per benchmark and configuration). N: strict-node F1; E: semantic-edge F1; P: PlanningScore $=0.5(N+E)$, using unrounded scores. All tasks contribute; the final row equally weights five configurations.
